fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human-readable stat name as shown on a level-up card (e.g. "Weapon Damage").

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Stat id
fields.description: The stat id key used in PlayerStats.stats (one of the 12: damage, crit, attack_speed, lifesteal, explosion, multitarget, slowmo, max_hp, speed, blast_resist, stamina, magnetic).

fields.name: rarity
fields.title: Card rarity
fields.description: Roll-draw rarity tier of this stat's level-up card. COMMON cards surface 4x as often as RARE (RARITY_WEIGHT common 4 / rare 2). Source player_stats.gd STAT_RARITY.

fields.name: maxPoints
fields.title: Max points per stat
fields.description: Hard cap on points allocatable into any single stat. Source player_stats.gd MAX_POINTS_PER_STAT = 5.

fields.name: perPointEffect
fields.title: Per-point effect
fields.description: How one allocated point shifts the stat. The live getter is base + delta*points (additive) OR 1.0 + mult*points (a multiplier on the target axis). Pulled from the PlayerStats getter formulas.

fields.name: mult
fields.title: Per-point multiplier term
fields.description: Added to a 1.0 base per point for multiplier-shaped stats (e.g. damage 0.20 -> 1.0 + 0.20*pts). Empty for purely additive stats.

fields.name: delta
fields.title: Per-point additive delta
fields.description: Added to a base value per point for additive stats (e.g. stamina +1/pt, crit chance +0.20/pt over base 0.25). Empty for pure multiplier stats.

fields.name: icon
fields.title: Icon
fields.description: Emoji or short glyph the level-up card shows for this stat.
